profile.assembly_scope: clang assembly from the optimized LLVM module; linked disassembly is separate

units_and_limits.allocations: managed Object headers, not malloc calls
units_and_limits.allocated_bytes: accounted managed Object/payload bytes, not allocator live bytes
units_and_limits.allocator_telemetry: allocator vtable operations are unavailable when the corresponding fields are absent
units_and_limits.gc_scanned_bytes: Object header bytes visited by the mark phase; inline UTF-16 units do not contain roots
units_and_limits.aot_helper_entries: instrumented ABI entries in the separate counter run; nested wrapper/fallback entries can both count, so these fields must not be summed as unique language calls
